Detailed Description

Toggling flip flop.

Toggles between zero and one upon receiving a trigger. 

     UGen trig = Dust::AR(5);
     UGen ff = ToggleFF::AR(trig) * 400 + 400;
     UGen output = SinOsc::AR(ff.lag(0.01), 0, 0.3);
